newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - Polish 3-month WIBOR seen at 19.15 end-96.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Polish 3-month WIBOR seen at 19.15 end-96.

text.p: The Warsaw Interbank Offered Rate (WIBOR) for three-month deposits is expected to fall to 18.59 percent by the end of the year from 19.36 percent on Tuesday, a Reuter poll of Poland's 24 biggest banks showed.
The prediction is a mean average of banks' forecasts ranging from 17.81 percent to 19.20 percent.
Last month, banks saw the rate at 19.15 percent on average at the end of 1996.
It is seen at 19.16 percent on average this month and at 16.87 percent in September 1997. Forecasts ranged between 18.50 and 19.8 percent and 15.26 and 18.90 percent, respectively.
